remarks: Great opportunity to own a 2-Bed, 1.5-Bath Condo in a prime up-and-coming downtown location at River Vista Condominiums!  This income-restricted condo offers an incredible opportunity to own in the heart of Stamford! Featuring two spacious bedrooms, 1.5 baths, this townhouse style unit is ready for your personal touch with minor cosmetic updates. Enjoy the convenience of being just steps from restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and public transportation. Purchase and sale contract is subject to approval by New Neighborhoods, LLC, the land trust owner. Unit must be owner-occupied at all times. No rentals allowed. Don't miss this chance to own in a fantastic location! Income Limit for a family of 2-4 ppl is $180,500. NOTE: After a purchase contract is accepted by seller, buyer will initiate the approval process required by New Neighborhoods. See attached instructions.
